$schema_note: Dograh http_api tool pack — Zeus portal actions (Phase 2). Conforms to dograh ToolModel / schemas/tool.py (HttpApiToolDefinition). Register each entry through Workflow Studio -> Tools or the dograh REST tool API; replace CREDENTIAL_UUID_ZEUS with the UUID of a stored dograh credential that sends the Zeus session as a header (e.g. type 'header', value 'pbx_session=<token>' — see zeus-tool-pack.md). Endpoints: zeus docs/portal-api.md.

tools.name: zeus_send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS text message from the account's Zeus DID (VoIP.ms) to a destination phone number. Use when the caller asks you to text them or you must deliver a short message by SMS.

parameters.name: to_number
parameters.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +13025551002.

parameters.name: from_did_id
parameters.description: The id of one of the caller's Zeus DIDs (ask them, or leave for the operator default).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The SMS text to send (max 1600 characters).

tools.name: zeus_check_voicemail
tools.description: List the account's Zeus voicemail messages (newest first), including caller id/name, duration, transcript, and AI summary when present. Use before summarizing or acting on voicemail.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many voicemails to fetch (1-100, default 20).

tools.name: zeus_voicemail_summary
tools.description: Generate (or refresh) the AI summary of one Zeus voicemail from its transcript, then return it. Use when the caller wants to know what a voicemail said.

parameters.name: voicemail_id
parameters.description: The id of the voicemail to summarise (from zeus_check_voicemail).

tools.name: zeus_voicemail_listened
tools.description: Mark a Zeus voicemail as handled/listened so it stops showing as new. Call after the caller has dealt with a voicemail.

parameters.name: voicemail_id
parameters.description: The id of the voicemail to mark listened.
